goal: Port callable-altitude parameter-quality rules onto v3: structure.sentinels (stringly-typed sentinel param -> Literal/Enum; directed WARNING verdict, new REPLACE_SENTINEL_TYPE action) and structure.hidden-mutators (in-place parameter mutation; REVIEW@WARNING since the remedy is intent-dependent). Consume Structure.over(callable).sentinel_parameters()/mutated_parameters() (proven). Legacy sentinels.py/hidden_mutators.py as oracle; v3 has no call-site cardinality data yet (observed_literals empty), so flag by name+type.

summary.title: Port structure.sentinels + structure.hidden-mutators
summary.what: Two callable-altitude parameter-quality rules. structure.sentinels: directed verdict (new REPLACE_SENTINEL_TYPE action) at WARNING, one per stringly-typed sentinel parameter, prescribing Literal/Enum. structure.hidden-mutators: REVIEW verdict at WARNING for in-place parameter mutation, gated by a min_mutations floor. Both consume the proven callable_measures metrics. Registry 12->14; 9 tests.
summary.why: Recovers the legacy sentinels + hidden_mutators parameter rules onto v3. Sentinels has a singular mechanical fix (directed corrective); hidden-mutators' remedy is intent-dependent (REVIEW).
summary.user_goal: Port callable-altitude parameter-quality rules onto v3: structure.sentinels (stringly-typed sentinel param -> Literal/Enum; directed WARNING verdict, new REPLACE_SENTINEL_TYPE action) and structure.hidden-mutators (in-place parameter mutation; REVIEW@WARNING since the remedy is intent-dependent). Consume Structure.over(callable).sentinel_parameters()/mutated_parameters() (proven). Legacy sentinels.py/hidden_mutators.py as oracle; v3 has no call-site cardinality data yet (observed_literals empty), so flag by name+type.

decisions.rationale: A sentinel str->Literal/Enum is a singular, mechanical fix — a directed corrective, not REVIEW.
rejected: REVIEW (the fix is not actually intent-dependent)

decisions.rationale: The mutation is a confident fact but the remedy depends on intent (accumulator/visitor vs accidental aliasing), so REVIEW; caps at WARNING, matching legacy severity.
rejected: Directed corrective at ERROR (would over-prescribe; in-place mutation is sometimes the intended contract)
